segments.ja482:1.1: Tassa [kassa (sī. pī.)] gāmavaraṃ dammi, nāriyo ca alaṅkatā;
segments.ja482:1.3: Yo [ko (sī. syā. pī.)] metaṃ migamakkhāti [makkhāsi (syā. ka.)], migānaṃ migamuttamaṃ.
segments.ja482:2.1: Mayhaṃ gāmavaraṃ dehi, nāriyo ca alaṅkatā;
segments.ja482:3.1: Etasmiṃ vanasaṇḍasmiṃ, ambā sālā ca pupphitā;
segments.ja482:4.1: Dhanuṃ advejjhaṃ [adejjhaṃ (sī. pī.), sarajjaṃ (ka.)] katvāna, usuṃ sannayhupāgami [sandhāyupāgami (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja482:4.3: Migo ca disvā rājānaṃ, dūrato ajjhabhāsatha.
segments.ja482:5.1: Āgamehi mahārāja, mā maṃ vijjhi rathesabha;
segments.ja482:5.3: Ko nu te idamakkhāsi, ettheso tiṭṭhate migo.
segments.ja482:6.1: Esa pāpacaro poso, samma tiṭṭhati ārakā;
segments.ja482:6.3: Soyaṃ [so hi (sī. syā. pī.)] me idamakkhāsi, ettheso tiṭṭhate migo.
segments.ja482:7.1: Saccaṃ kireva māhaṃsu, narā ekacciyā idha;
segments.ja482:7.3: Kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo, na tvevekacci yo naro.
segments.ja482:8.1: Kiṃ nu ruru garahasi migānaṃ, kiṃ pakkhīnaṃ kiṃ pana mānusānaṃ;
segments.ja482:8.3: Bhayañhi maṃ vindatinapparūpaṃ, sutvāna taṃ mānusiṃ bhāsamānaṃ.
segments.ja482:9.1: Yamuddhariṃ vāhane vuyhamānaṃ, mahodake salile sīghasote;
segments.ja482:9.3: Tatonidānaṃ bhayamāgataṃ mama, dukkho have rāja asabbhi saṅgamo.
segments.ja482:10.1: Sohaṃ catuppattamimaṃ vihaṅgamaṃ, tanucchidaṃ hadaye ossajāmi;
segments.ja482:10.3: Hanāmi taṃ mittadubbhiṃ akiccakāriṃ [hanāmi mittaddu’ makiccakāriṃ (sī. pī.)], yo tādisaṃ kammakataṃ na jāne.
segments.ja482:11.1: Dhīrassa bālassa have janinda, santo vadhaṃ nappasaṃsanti jātu;
segments.ja482:11.3: Kāmaṃ gharaṃ gacchatu pāpadhammo, yañcassa bhaṭṭhaṃ tadetassa dehi;
segments.ja482:12.1: Addhā ruru aññataro sataṃ so [sataṃ’ se (sī.)], yo dubbhato [dubbhino (syā.), dūbhato (pī.)] mānusassa na dubbhi;
segments.ja482:12.3: Kāmaṃ gharaṃ gacchatu pāpadhammo, yañcassa bhaṭṭhaṃ tadetassa dammi;
segments.ja482:14.1: Api ce maññatī poso, ñāti mitto sakhāti vā;
segments.ja482:14.3: Yo pubbe sumano hutvā, pacchā sampajjate diso.
segments.ja482:15.3: Migā sassāni khādanti, taṃ devo paṭisedhatu.
segments.ja482:16.3: Na tvevāhaṃ ruruṃ dubbhe, datvā abhayadakkhiṇaṃ.
segments.ja482:17.1: Mā me janapado āsi [mā maṃ janapado ahu (syā.)], raṭṭhañcāpi vinassatu;
segments.ja482:17.3: Na tvevāhaṃ [na tveva (ka. sī. ka.)] migarājassa, varaṃ datvā musā bhaṇeti.
